featured_reviews.name: Trusha Kahar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at this salon. Initially, the owner quoted me higher prices for waxing, manicure, and pedicure services. However, when I checked the rate card inside, the actual prices were ₹100–₹150 lower per service. Despite this, I decided to proceed since I was in a hurry.
Unfortunately, things only got worse from there. While the waxing and eyebrows were manageable, the manicure and pedicure were extremely poorly done. During the manicure, my cuticles were cut so harshly that I started bleeding and had to hold cotton for quite some time to stop it. The pedicure was even worse—my heel cracks were left untreated, nail shapes were uneven despite clearly requesting short and round nails, and overall the work was very unprofessional.
To make matters worse, the massage was done with an overly oily cream that had hair stuck in it, which was extremely unhygienic.
When I shared my feedback, I expected at least some acknowledgment or concern. Instead, the owner became defensive and claimed that certain things were “complimentary,” including a basic scrub and even nail polish—which, surprisingly, wasn’t even included in their so-called package. The nail polish they did offer was dried out, and I eventually asked them to skip it altogether.
Overall, a very unpleasant and unprofessional experience. I would not recommend this salon if you’re looking for hygiene, transparency, or quality service.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Review left on my wife’s behalf (her own words):

Request traveller to India’s but My first time with a Lakme Salon although I have tried their make up.
I found them online and they were very near my hotel so I thought I would give them a try.  I tried to book online but did not get a response so booked over the phone.
When I arrived a was seen to straight away.  I had booked for a haircut and manicure/pedicure.  I wanted gel polish but only had two hours so dropped this option.
I was satisfied with the haircut and  manicure/pedicure.  My criticism is with the service received which resulted in me not leaving a tip and I will not go back again sadly.
I had two lovely ladies who did my manicure and pedicure at the same time.  Again I was made to feel guilty for asking for chocolate one.  They wanted me to go for very berry.  Again tried to make me feel guilty and told me I had not chosen the right one.  The lady who was doing my pedicure was called away as her brother was ill.  Hope he is better.  So I felt the end of this service was rushed.  As I did not go for gel the options for nail polish was limited and was in a rundown box that looked tatty.
The haircut - The lady who cut my hair wanted to upsell me a hair spa and treatment but I only wanted a cut a blow dry, she was clearly not happy with this.  I only had two hours and I have access to a spa at my gym so I was not interested.  She cut my hair but took a phonecall during the cut and then disappeared to go on her phone without telling me.  Not very good customer service. She did a blow dry but it did not last the evening.
Sadly I will not return but hopefully this feedback will help you to improve for the future and live up to the brand that Lakme has made over so many years.
